blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary proxies for within-block omissions while preserving the total block-derived advantage across its tokens. Under a fixed-weight additive page utility, we show that element-indexed contrasts retain local quality differences that page-level aggregation can cancel out. In the main experimental comparison, P2TPO outperforms all evaluated policy optimization baselines in seed-averaged scores on each of the six document parsing benchmarks. Additional experiments demonstrate gains across model scales and initializations.
blocks.zh: 端到端的全页文档解析必须保留不同元素的内容和结构,而否则准确的产出可能包含局部出错和遗漏. 单一的页面优势没有明确确定在抽样产出中哪些内容在质量上有所不同,或出现错误。 我们采用Page-to-token政策优化(P2TPO),这是一个结构相协调的信用分配框架,在全页政策轨迹上运作。 参考元素对接第一关联区块级质量与生成跨度的对比. 统一Anchor定价(UAP)包含匹配和缺失的元素结果,并在抽样产出获得相同但不完整的参考要素分数时提供与固定质量上限相比的反馈. 在相匹配的区块内,Span信用再分配(SCR)根据对齐的正确和错误的跨度重新分配现有区块信用,使用边界代用符来弥补区块内遗漏,同时保留其代用符上总的区块衍生优势. 在固定重量的添加剂页面工具下,我们显示元素索引对比保留了本地质量差异,页面级汇总可以抵消. 在主要实验性比较中,P2TPO在六个文件分析基准中每个基准的种子平均分数上都超过了所有评价的政策优化基线。 其他实验表明,在模型尺度和初始化方面都取得了收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: End-to-end document parsers transcribe images of digital documents, scans, and photographs into a single structured sequence in reading order ( Blecher et al., 2024 ; Taghadouini et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2025 ) . We study full-page Markdown transcription, with faithful text, L a T e X formulas, and HTML tables. Dense heterogeneous content, skew, warping, and uneven illumination challenge accuracy and completeness ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Errors are often local: an otherwise accurate output may corrupt a formula, omit words, or miss an entire element.
blocks.zh: 端到端文档解析器将数字文档的图像,扫描和相片按照读取顺序转换成一个单一的结构序列(Blecher等,2024;Taghadouini等,2026;Oyang等,2025;Du等,2025). 我们研究全页的Markdown转录,有忠实的文本,L a T e X公式和HTML表格. 各种内容、扭曲、扭曲和不均匀的照明对准确性和完整性构成挑战(欧阳等,2025;周等,2026)。 出错往往是局部的:否则准确的输出可能会损坏一个公式,省略单词,或者错过整个元素.

blocks.en: Supervised next-token learning serves as the foundation for these parsers, while reinforcement learning (RL) is used for post-training optimization of reference-based measures for fully generated documents. These measures evaluate content accuracy, structural fidelity, and completeness. Recent parsers highlight the effectiveness of reinforcement learning in post-training through layout-aware rewards and verifiable unit tests ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Poznanski et al., 2025 ) . A key question for full-page transcription is how to convert these measurements into feedback that corrects missing or corrupted content while preserving correctly transcribed sections.
blocks.zh: 受监督的相邻学习是这些解析器的基础,而强化学习(RL)则用于对完全生成的文件进行基于参考措施的训练后优化. 这些措施评价内容准确性、结构忠诚性和完整性。 近期的解说者强调通过布局意识奖励和可核查的单位测试在培训后加强学习的有效性(Wang等,2025;Chen等,2025;Poznski等,2025)。 全页抄录的一个关键问题是,如何将这些测量结果转换成反馈,在正确保存抄录部分的同时纠正缺失或被腐蚀的内容.

blocks.en: With page-level outcome rewards, GRPO assigns one response advantage to all generated tokens ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Yet two outputs of the same page can receive similar overall scores while making opposite local errors: one transcribes a formula correctly but omits a table, whereas the other recovers the table and corrupts the formula (Figure 1 (a)). A shared response coefficient does not preserve these element-specific contrasts. GDPO normalizes reward dimensions separately before combining them into a shared response coefficient ( Liu et al., 2026b ) ; CSPO routes table-wide functional-attribute advantages to corresponding tokens ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is the remaining reference-instance question: how to compare corresponding individual elements across full-page outputs, include missing outcomes, and allocate their signed credit to generated positions.
blocks.zh: GRPO赋予所有生成的符号一个响应优势, 然而,同一页的两个产出可以在作出相反的局部错误的同时获得类似的总分:一个是正确转录一个公式,但省略一个表格,而另一个是恢复了表格并腐蚀了公式(图1(a))。 共享响应系数不能保持这些元素特定对比. GDPO将奖励维度分别规范化后再合并为共享响应系数(Liu等,2026b;CSPO路由全表功能属性优势为相应的符(Yang等,2026). 我们的焦点是其余的参考问题:如何在全页产出中比较相应的个别要素,包括缺失的结果,并将其签名的信用分配给生成的职位。

blocks.en: We analyze this phenomenon at three levels. First, reference identity maintains contrasts between individual elements, including instances of the same type. Second, element-wise comparisons must account for missing outcomes and retain feedback when all outcomes are equally imperfect: an omitted element lacks a generated span, and centering tied scores diminishes its relative signal. Third, feedback must differentiate erroneous positions from correct content within a matched block, rather than assigning uniform credit across the block. Together, the four failure modes illustrated in Figure 1 (b) highlight three key requirements: preserve element identity, complete the comparison outcomes, and control where credit is assigned.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个层面分析这一现象。 首先,参考身份在单个元素之间保持了对比,包括同类型实例. 第二,基于元素的比较必须考虑到缺失结果,并在所有结果同样不完美时保留反馈:一个被遗漏的元素缺少一个生成的跨度,而中标的分数会减少其相对信号. 第三,反馈必须区分在相应区块内的错误立场和正确内容,而不是在整个区块内给予统一的信用。 图1(b)所示的四种故障模式加在一起,突出了三项关键要求:保持要素特性、完成比较结果并控制发放信贷的地点。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Schematic motivation for structure-aware feedback. (a) Similar page rewards hide local differences. (b) Coarse feedback obscures block identity, shared errors, and error/omission locations. (c) Structure-aware feedback retains element identity and assigns local credit. Rewards and serialized content are illustrative; training outputs use HTML tables.
blocks.zh: 图1:结构意识反馈的结构性动机。 (a) 类似的页面奖励掩盖了当地的差异。 (b) 粗糙的反馈模糊了块身份、共同错误和出错/出错地点。 (c) 结构意识反馈保留要素特性并分配当地信贷。 奖励和系列内容是说明性的;培训产出使用HTML表格。

blocks.en: We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), which assigns local credit while retaining full-page generation and page-level feedback (Figure 1 (c)). It first aligns each output to reference elements so that corresponding instances can be compared across rollouts. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) completes these comparisons with missing outcomes and uses a quality ceiling to retain feedback at imperfect consensus. Matched coefficients act on generated blocks; whole-element omissions act through existing boundary tokens. Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) then reallocates an eligible matched block’s coefficient toward aligned errors when negative and correct positions when positive, preserving its sign and total credit mass. The final update combines this local feedback with the shared page term.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Page-to-token政策优化(P2TPO),它分配了本地信用,同时保留了全页生成和页面级反馈(图1(c))。 它首先将每个输出都与参考元素相匹配,以便可以在整个推出过程中比较相应的实例. 统一Anchor Pricing(UAP)完成这些与缺失结果的比较,并使用质量上限将反馈保留在不完美的共识. 相匹配系数在生成的块上作用;全元素省略通过已存在的边界符号作用. Span信用再分配(SCR),然后将符合条件的区块系数重新分配到正时负和正时位置的对齐错误,保留其标志和总信用质量。 最后更新将本地反馈与共享的页面名词相结合.

blocks.en: Our contributions are fourfold: • Reference-element credit assignment. We retain individual element identities across full-page rollouts and characterize the local quality contrasts that aggregation can erase under a fixed-weight additive page utility. • Complete outcome feedback. We propose the UAP, which outlines a unified set of rules for handling matches, managing missing values, and addressing uniformly imperfect outcomes. This includes a feedback mechanism for instances where an entire element is absent. • Budget-preserving intra-block redistribution. We developed the SCR mechanism, which reallocates block credits while preserving both the sign and the total amount of matched block credits. We proved the conservation of credits and specified the conditions under which informative masks can increase the allocation to the target position. • Empirical effectiveness and generality. Using a shared supervised checkpoint, matched update budgets, and a five-seed run, P2TPO outperforms four response-level baselines on all 13 primary splits across six benchmarks that include digital documents, scanned pages, and real-world photographs. In addition, across three different model and initialization settings, it achieves the highest mean in 37 out of 39 comparisons of splits and settings.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款有四分之一:参考额度信贷分配。 我们保留了全页的单个元素身份,并描述在固定重量添加剂页面功能下,聚合可以消除的地方质量对比。 • 完整的结果反馈。 我们提出UAP,它概述了一套统一的处理匹配,管理缺失值和处理统一不完善结果的规则. 这包括对缺少整个要素的情况的反馈机制。 • 预算保留区内再分配。 我们开发了SCR机制,它重新分配了积分,同时保留了相应的积分的标志和总额. 我们证明了保留信用,并具体说明了信息口罩可以增加分配给目标位置的条件。 • 经验效力和普遍性。 P2TPO利用共同监管的检查站、匹配更新预算和五种种子运行,在所有13个主要划分基准(包括数字文件、扫描页和真实世界照片)上,P2TPO都超过了4个响应级别基线。 此外,在三种不同的模型和初始化设置中,它实现了39个拆分和设置比较中的37个中最高的平均值.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Given a page image, its reference document, and a set of sampled full-page outputs, P2TPO assigns a single coefficient to each generated token. Reference alignment identifies corresponding elements across outputs. UAP converts matched and missing outcomes into element coefficients; SCR redistributes eligible matched coefficients within their generated blocks, while whole-element omissions use a separate boundary route. These local terms combine with a shared page coefficient and enter the policy update. Generation and policy updates retain full-page autoregressive conditioning.
blocks.zh: P2TPO考虑到一个页面图像、其参考文件以及一组样本的全页输出,为每个生成的符号分配一个单一系数。 参考资料统一确定各项产出的相应要素。 UAP将匹配和缺失的结果转换为元素系数;SCR在其生成的块内重新分配符合匹配的系数,而整体遗漏则使用单独的边界路径. 这些本地术语与共享的页面系数结合,并输入政策更新. 生成和政策更新保留了整页自递性条件。

blocks.en: Figure 2: P2TPO overview. (a) P2BPO aligns reference elements, normalizes matched outcomes, and broadcasts block credit. (b) UAP incorporates missing outcomes and imperfect-consensus feedback; SCR redistributes matched-block credit under a conserved budget. (c) The complete pipeline combines local token credit with page feedback. Missing-block coefficients reach boundary tokens directly, bypassing SCR.
blocks.zh: 图2:P2TPO概况. (a) P2BPO调整参考要素,使结果符合标准,并广播块信用。 (b) 《普遍行动计划》纳入了缺失的结果和不完全一致的反馈;《战略成果框架》在节省的预算下重新分配匹配块信贷。 (c) 整个管道将当地象征性信用与页面反馈相结合。 缺失块系数直接到达边界符号,绕过SCR.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: End-to-end parsers such as Donut and Nougat generate structured documents directly from images ( Kim et al., 2022 ; Blecher et al., 2024 ) . Recent systems extend this setting to diverse layouts and capture conditions ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Reinforcement post-training introduces rewards for transcription, layout, reading order, output validity, and structural fidelity ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Poznanski et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Hunyuan Vision Team et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Table- and element-specific approaches further tailor the prediction unit and reward to local content ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . These systems motivate heterogeneous quality measures, while P2TPO studies how feedback for individual reference elements reaches tokens within a full-page rollout. Appendix A.1 compares reward units and optimization supports.
blocks.zh: Donut和Nougat等端到端解析器直接从图像生成结构化文档(Kim等,2022;Blecher等,2024.). 最近的系统将这种设置扩大到不同的布局和捕捉条件(Cai等,2026;Lu等,2026.). 强化后培训引入了对抄写,排版,阅读顺序,产出有效性,和结构忠诚的奖励(王等,2025;黄等,2026;陈等,2025;波兹南斯基等,2025;王等,2026a;湖南远景). Team等,2025;张等,2026. 表格和元素特定方法进一步调整预测单位并奖励当地内容(Zhang等,2025;Li等,2026a; Wang et al., 2026c.) (中文(简体) ). 这些系统刺激了各种质量衡量标准,而P2TPO则研究单个参考要素的反馈如何在一整页的推出中达到信号. 附录A.1比较奖励单位和优化支持.

blocks.en: GRPO and RLOO construct response advantages from sampled groups without a learned critic ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) . GSPO uses sequence-level importance weighting and clipping, while DAPO and Dr. GRPO revise sampling, clipping, reduction, or normalization ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . GDPO, RDPO, and GD 2 PO address the normalization and interaction of multiple reward dimensions ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . NGRPO combines virtual-maximum calibration with asymmetric clipping to learn from homogeneous failures ( Nan et al., 2025 ) . UAP shares ceiling-informed feedback, while unifying missing outcomes and imperfect reward consensus within reference-element comparisons and routing their feedback to generated tokens. Appendix C.1.4 details the evaluated baselines; Appendix A.1 compares reward interfaces.
blocks.zh: GRPO和RLOO从没有学识丰富的评论家的抽样群体中构建反应优势(Shao等,2024;Ahmadian等,2024.). 普惠制O采用序列级重要性加权和剪接,而DAPO和GRPO博士则修订抽样、剪接、减少或正常化(郑等,2025;于等,2025a;刘等,2025.). GDPO、RDPO和GD 2 PO处理多个奖励层面的正常化和相互作用(刘等,2026b; Bai等,2026;Liu等,2026a.). NGRPO将虚拟-最大校正与不对称剪接相结合,从同质失败中吸取教训(Nan等,2025年). UAP共享基于上限的反馈,同时在参考要素比较中统一缺失的结果和不完善的奖励共识,并将其反馈导向生成的符号. 附录C.1.4详细列出了评估的基准;附录A.1比较了奖励接口。

blocks.en: Process supervision evaluates reasoning steps ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) ; GiGPO compares repeated environment states while retaining trajectory feedback ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . CSPO extends GRPO with table-wide functional-attribute rewards whose normalized advantages are routed to corresponding tokens alongside global feedback ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . P2TPO performs local comparisons for individual reference-block instances in full-page rollouts, preserving quality differences between elements of the same type and supporting omission feedback and intra-block redistribution. Functional-attribute assessment and reference-instance comparison are complementary; Appendix A.2 discusses possible adaptations.
blocks.zh: 过程监督评价推理步骤(Lightman等,2024;Wang等,2024;GIGPO比较了重复的环境状态,同时保留了轨迹反馈(Feng等,2025. CSPO将GRPO扩展为全表功能属性奖励,其常态优势与全球反馈并列到相应的符号上(Yang等,2026年). P2TPO在全页推出时对单个参考区块实例进行本地比较,保留同类型要素的质量差异,支持遗漏反馈和区块内部再分配. 功能属性评估和参考比较是相辅相成的;附录A.2讨论了可能的调整。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise specified, “seeds” refers to distinct RL training runs rather than repeated evaluations of a fixed checkpoint. The reported means and standard deviations summarize benchmark scores across these training runs.
The experiments test whether reference-element feedback improves full-page parsing, whether UAP and SCR contribute to those gains, and whether alignment-informed placement matters beyond nonuniform weighting. Additional settings assess applicability across initializations, model scales, and backbones; parameter sweeps and a 500-update study examine sensitivity to credit parameters and training horizon.
blocks.zh:
除非另有说明,“种子”是指单独的RL训练,而不是对固定检查站的反复评价。 所报告的手段和标准偏差总结了这些培训活动的基准分数。
实验测试参考元素反馈是否改进了全页解析,UAP和SCR是否为这些收益出力,以及是否对齐知情的放置事项超越了非统一加权. 其他设置评估了初始化、模型尺度和主干网的适用性;参数扫描和一项500更新研究审查了对信用参数和培训视野的敏感性。

blocks.en: We compare P2TPO with four response-level policy optimization baselines: GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , GDPO ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , and RDPO ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . P2BPO and its +UAP and +SCR variants serve as component ablations. Appendix C.1.4 details the comparison methods.

Scores compare methods within each benchmark: five benchmarks use the shared OmniDocBench evaluator, while FinixDocBench pools its Digital and Photo tracks using its official evaluator. Real5 and Wild reuse OmniDocBench source pages and assess capture robustness. Appendix C.1.5 specifies the evaluated scope and score definitions, including the adapted DocPTBench composite.

blocks.en: Matched-element comparisons account for a substantial part of the gain: P2BPO exceeds the strongest response-level baseline in mean Overall score on 12 of 13 splits, with the largest margins on PureDocBench Clean (+0.72 points) and FinixDocBench (+0.67 points; Table 1 ). blocks.en: SCR benefits most consistently from UAP’s completed and calibrated feedback. With UAP enabled, adding SCR improves the mean on 11 of 13 splits, led by PureDocBench Digital (+0.77) and Clean (+0.70); without UAP, it improves two of 13 splits. Adding UAP to P2BPO + SCR improves 12 of 13 splits. Full P2TPO attains the highest mean among the four component configurations on ten splits (Table 1 ). These descriptive five-seed comparisons support the complementarity of feedback construction and token allocation.

Full P2TPO also has lower observed across-seed standard deviations than the λ = 0 \lambda=0 configuration on all 13 splits. These interventions assess UAP’s feedback and delivery rules; Appendix C.2.1 gives their definitions and detailed comparisons.

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of token placement, we preserve each eligible block’s coefficient values and selected-token count while randomizing their positions. Aligned SCR exceeds random support in mean score on 12 of 13 splits and circular shift on ten (Table 2 (b)). Random support and circular shift exceed uniform allocation on two and three splits, respectively. These comparisons support alignment-informed placement beyond nonuniform weighting alone; Appendix C.2.2 gives the protocols and detailed results.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
P2TPO constructs element-level feedback from ground-truth references, so its alignment and quality scores depend on annotation accuracy and serialization conventions. Annotation noise, repeated text, and alternative valid serializations can introduce ambiguity into element matching and token labels. Reliable references and alignment procedures are therefore important conditions for applying the framework.
Our experiments focus on text, formulas, and tables; code and figures are not evaluated as distinct element types. Extending the framework to these elements requires suitable representations, alignment procedures, and quality measures. Future work could investigate their joint optimization within an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework.
Finally, SCR currently allocates credit between aligned correct and erroneous token regions, with a shared redistribution weight within each region. Quality gating and cap-and-rebate redistribution bound concentration while preserving the source block’s credit budget. Distinguishing individual token contributions within these regions is a direction for finer localization, with its effects on optimization to be evaluated.
blocks.zh:
P2TPO从地面真实的参考文献中构建出元素级反馈,因此其校正和质量分数取决于注释准确性和序列化惯例. 注释噪声,重复文本,和可替代的有效序列化可以给元素匹配和符号标签带来模糊. 因此,可靠的参考和统一程序是适用该框架的重要条件。
我们的实验侧重于文本、公式和表格;代码和数字没有被评价为不同的要素类型。 将框架扩大到这些要素需要适当的表述、协调程序和质量措施。 今后的工作可以在一个从头到尾的强化学习框架内调查它们的共同优化情况。
最后,SCR目前将信用分配到对等和错标的区域之间,并在每个区域内部分担再分配权重. 在保持源块信贷预算的同时, 区分这些区域内的个人象征性贡献是更细化本地化的方向,对优化的影响有待评估。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced P2TPO for structure-aligned RL post-training of full-page document parsers. It preserves reference-element identity, completes feedback for missing outcomes and imperfect consensus through UAP, and localizes matched-block credit through budget-preserving SCR. Our analysis characterizes local quality contrasts that fixed additive aggregation can erase. From a shared supervised checkpoint, P2TPO exceeds four response-level baselines in five-seed mean score on all 13 primary splits across six benchmarks, including a 0.74-point gain over the strongest baseline on OmniDocBench v1.6. Additional settings and ablations support its applicability and the complementarity of outcome feedback and alignment-informed token allocation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了P2TPO,用于全页文档解析器的结构相匹配RL后训练. 它保留了参考元素特性,通过UAP完成了对缺失结果和不完善共识的反馈,并通过保留预算的SCR对匹配块信用进行本地化. 我们的分析定性为当地质量的对比,即固定添加剂聚合可以去除. P2TPO通过一个共同的受监管检查站,在所有13个主要分数中以5个种子的平均分数超过4个响应级别基线,分为6个基准,包括比OmniDoc Bench v1.6最强基线增加0.74分。 其他设置和拼图支持其适用性,支持成果反馈的互补性以及信息一致的象征性分配。

blocks.en: HunyuanOCR’s row describes its document-parsing RL recipe, not every task supported by the model. LightOnOCR’s row covers its OCR recipe; its separate bounding-box recipe uses IoU-based localization rewards and is not element transcription. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 uses layout detection followed by task-prompted region recognition; its RL tasks include text, formulas, and tables as well as charts, seals, and spotting. blocks.en: The evaluated response-level baselines are GRPO, GSPO, GDPO, and RDPO; P2BPO, +UAP, and +SCR are component controls (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 评估的响应级别基线是GRPO、GSPO、GDPO和RDPO;P2BPO、+UAP和+SCR是组件控制(表1)。

blocks.en: GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) standardizes scalar page rewards within each prompt’s rollout group and broadcasts the resulting advantage across each response. GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) retains group-relative response advantages while using length-normalized sequence importance ratios and sequence-level clipping. GDPO ( Liu et al., 2026b ) normalizes each reward dimension separately within the rollout group, aggregates the normalized dimensions, and applies batch-wise advantage normalization. RDPO ( Bai et al., 2026 ) applies magnitude-aware quantile normalization followed by Mahalanobis whitening within active reward subspaces before aggregation. Each evaluated interface produces one advantage per sampled response.
blocks.zh: GRPO (Shao等人, 2024年) 规范了每个提示推出组的分页奖励, 普惠制O(郑等,2025年)保留了群相相应反应的优势,同时使用长度常态化序列重要性比和序列级剪接. GDPO(Liu等,2026b)在推出组内分别实现每个奖励维度的正常化,汇总已规范维度,并实行分批实现优势正常化. RDPO(Bai等,2026年)采用能分级识别的四分法,然后在积极奖励子空间内将Mahalanobis白化后再聚合。 每个评估的接口每个抽样答复都产生一个优势。

blocks.en: P2BPO assigns relative advantages to matched reference blocks alongside page feedback. Its +UAP variant adds outcome completion, consensus feedback, and omission routing; +SCR redistributes matched-block credit w/o UAP. Full P2TPO combines both components (Appendix B.2 ).

blocks.en: C.1.5 Benchmark protocols and score conventions
blocks.zh: C.1.5 基准议定书和计分公约

blocks.en: We evaluate frozen checkpoints w/o benchmark-specific fine-tuning. OmniDocBench v1.6, Real5-OmniDocBench, Wild-OmniDocBench, DocPTBench, and PureDocBench all use the repository’s OmniDocBench v1.6 evaluation engine. FinixDocBench alone uses its official Markdown evaluator through the repository adapter. Prompts, decoding, preprocessing, and post-processing are fixed across methods within each benchmark. All headline scores range from 0 to 100, with higher values better.
blocks.zh: 我们评价被冻结的检查站的微调。 OmniDoc Bench v1.6, Real5-OmniDoc Bench, Wild-OmniDoc Bench, DoCPT Bench, 和PureDoc Bench 都使用了寄存器的OmniDoc Bench v1.6的评价引擎. FinixDoc Bench单独通过寄存器使用其官方的Markdown评价器. 提示、解码、预处理和后处理在每个基准内采用不同方法固定。 所有头条分数从0到100分不等,更高的值更好.

blocks.en: We evaluate the complete published DocPTBench Photographed (SynReal) and Unwarping (Dewarp) sets, each containing 1,381 images ( Du et al., 2025 ; DocPTBench authors, 2025 ) . SynReal comprises 981 simulated captures and 400 real photographs of 100 source documents under four conditions; Dewarp rectifies the entire Photographed set. Only parsing is evaluated: translation metrics such as BLEU, chrF, METEOR, and STEDS are not used.
blocks.zh: 我们评价完整出版的DocPT Bench摄影(SynReal)和Unwarping(Dewarp)集,每集包含1,381个图像(Du等人,2025年;DocPT Bench作者,2025年)。 SynReal由981个模拟捕捉器和400个真实相片组成100个来源文件在4个条件下组成; Dewarp校正了整个相片集. 只评价解析:不使用BLEU、ChrF、METEOR和STEDS等翻译指标。

blocks.en: FinixDocBench combines the 242 Digital pages and 300 Photo pages into one 542-page evaluation set; Track 3 Huge is excluded. We report pooled metrics for this combined set, rather than separate track scores or an equal-weight mean of two track-level scores. Real5-OmniDocBench and Wild-OmniDocBench reuse OmniDocBench source pages and should be interpreted as related robustness evaluations.

blocks.en: The UAP ablations in Table 2 follow the primary configuration in Table 7 , using full P2TPO’s five paired seeds and keeping the mixing weight ω \omega fixed. • P2TPO w/o consensus feedback ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ). blocks.en: Full P2TPO has higher means than the no-consensus and no-routing variants on eight and 11 of 13 splits, respectively (Table 2 ). blocks.en: Removing SCR ( β = 0 \beta=0 ) eliminates both nonuniform weighting and its alignment with token correctness. We therefore compare aligned SCR with two controls that retain the redistribution strength while changing where credit is assigned. The existing full P2TPO and P2TPO w/o SCR (P2BPO + UAP) results in Table 1 provide the aligned and uniform reference configurations.
blocks.zh: 删除 SCR (β = 0\β = 0) 既消除了非统一加权,又消除了与符号正确性相匹配. 因此,我们比较了调整后的SCR与两个控制,这两个控制保留了再分配的力量,同时改变了分配信贷的地方。 现有的完整的P2TPO和P2TPO w/o SCR(P2BPO + UAP)结果在表1中提供了一致和统一的参考配置.

blocks.en: Both controls follow the primary five-run configuration in Table 7 , retaining UAP, page feedback, and the remaining training settings. Perturbations operate only on valid tokens within eligible matched blocks, after SCR has computed its final coefficients. The original mask selects error spans for negative block credit and correct positions for positive block credit.
blocks.zh: 这两种控制都遵循表7中的主要五运行配置,保留UAP,页面反馈,以及其余的训练设置. 在SCR计算出其最终系数之后,扰动只在合格匹配区块内的有效地标上进行。 原始口罩为负块信用选择出错跨度,为正块信用选择正确位置.

blocks.en: The SCR columns of Table 2 compare the two controls with aligned SCR and uniform allocation. Differences below are in mean Overall-score points. • Alignment-informed placement. The largest gains over random support occur on PureDocBench Real (+1.00), FinixDocBench (+0.89), and PureDocBench Clean (+0.84); over circular shift, the largest gains occur on PureDocBench Digital/Clean (+0.95/+0.83). • Comparison with uniform allocation. Together with the cross-split counts in Section 4.3 , these comparisons show that preserving coefficient values and selected-token counts generally does not reproduce aligned SCR’s gains. Alignment-informed placement contributes beyond nonuniform weighting alone. • Control-specific patterns. Circular shifts outperform random support in mean scores across nine splits. Additionally, they surpass aligned SCR on FinixDocBench (+0.06) and on DocPTBench SynReal/Dewarp (+0.42/+0.18), respectively. Furthermore, random support exceeds aligned SCR on Dewarp (+0.07). Among these configurations, uniform allocation yields the highest mean score on Real5-OmniDocBench Scanning and DocPTBench Dewarp.

blocks.en: The primary 100-update P2TPO run requires approximately 60 GPU-hours on eight high-performance computing cards. The full credit-assignment mechanism takes 1.215 s/update, compared with 0.707 s/update for GRPO, adding 0.51 s/update, equivalent to approximately 0.19% of per-update wall time. The recorded advantage-computation shares are 0.465% for P2TPO and 0.265% for GRPO. Generation and actor-update timing distributions are comparable to GRPO.

blocks.en: We establish three properties of the credit construction: the information lost by aggregation, the feedback restored by UAP, and the conditions under which SCR increases allocation to effective targets. The aggregation model uses common matched rollouts and a fixed additive utility; the UAP and SCR results concern the coefficients defined in Section 2 .

blocks.en: Figures 7 – 9 supplement Section 4.3 with selected OmniDocBench v1.6 outputs from separate GRPO and P2TPO runs after 100 training updates.
